'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title is a handwritten formula. Have One → [[Home One]]. Guy No Tap → [[Goo Nee Tay]]. Switcher/Swilla → [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)]]. Glintener → [[Grimtaash]]. Qui-Gon's Blaster Rifle as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Pistone]]

* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
